info.name: Wagestream Integrations Off Cycle Payment API
Check status of a previous submission of Off-cycle payments

params.name: txn_id
params.description: The transaction ID, as returned by the original `POST` request

items.docs: A successful POST to `/off-cycle-payments` returns a `txn_id`, which is needed to query the status of the operation

info.name: Notify Wagestream of one or more offcycle payment for an employee

items.docs: Inserts expenses to be expected by employee at specified dates.
